reason: Current September 2026 evidence conflicts with the July class-wide candidate tariff. Two independent current station records for Uattzy partyId UTZ at Palmanova, each with exact UTZ EVSE IDs and 22 kW Type 2 connectors, report direct ad-hoc charging at 0.62 EUR/kWh, whereas the July 2026 specialist report stated POS Quick at 0.61 EUR/kWh. The current first-party Uattzy FAQ also explicitly says connector tariffs and possible additional costs are shown per connector and may vary based on delivered power, session duration and bay occupancy. Without a current first-party backend/tariff document proving a complete deterministic class grid and exceptions, class-wide promotion is unsafe. Fail closed and return UTZ to station-level.
